body: **Integration fix on agents-s1 (orchestrator, 6db853d).** `src/main/autoUpdate.test.ts` already fails on main b1720ff. Commit 3f0e33a ("ticket time") shortened `formatUpdateReadyMessage` to "Version X is ready.", the auto-revert put the long message back, and the mascot merge (2cf6d6a) kept the test that expects the short one. I applied the person's intended short message on agents-s1 so the sprint's full `npm test` can pass. This is a one-line source change, and the existing test covers it. `main` itself still has the failure until this epic merges.
